_about: Expected results of the PDF drawing check (crosscheck/) on the COMOS sheet =P1.H4.FB.001 and its vector PDF (tests/test_pdf_crosscheck.py). Data only: the module knows none of these tags, sizes or files.
_drawn_only_already_linked: proteus_topology step 2b (fittings drawn straight onto another item) already links both pairs, so loading the files as they are makes no candidates: the PDF confirms them

neo4j._without_step_2b: the candidate path, tested by loading the sheet without the step 2b links (as a loader without that rule reads it): the PDF then proposes the 2 pairs
neo4j._flows: with =P1.H3.FB.001 loaded too; the H4 pairs join F001 -> P002 (P1.H4.T1) -> k001
